sources.name: GCN Circulars
sources.result: All ten new bodies were read. Four event groups selected. GCN 46303 (GRB 261113B GECAM-B duration only) was scientifically incremental relative to the already reported reclassification and omitted as a separate public story. No correction or retraction appeared in this range.

sources.name: Astronomer’s Telegram
sources.result: No telegram newer than 18156 was posted by the cutoff.

sources.name: IceCube
sources.result: Read GCN 46307 and the complete event group. No newer IceCube candidate was exposed in the checked official/GCN surfaces.

sources.name: GraceDB and LVK
sources.result: The public REST query returned zero superevents created in the window. The separate Latest page displayed inconsistent/stale event rows; modern Kafka alerts were not independently enumerated.

sources.name: Gamma-ray and X-ray missions
sources.result: Screened all in-range GCN bodies from GECAM, SVOM/ECLAIRs, Konus-Wind, Glowbug and optical follow-up teams. No new Einstein Probe event circular occurred in 46301–46310.

sources.name: KM3NeT
sources.result: Targeted official and GCN searches exposed no in-window alert; no complete public live-alert ledger was available, so quiet cannot be verified.

sources.name: Ground arrays and cosmic-ray facilities
sources.result: Targeted official/GCN searches exposed no qualifying in-window astrophysical alert. This is not a claim that all private or machine streams were quiet.

screened_not_selected.reason: GECAM-B supplied T90 only; incremental confirmation of an event and reclassification already covered on 16 November.

corrections_and_retractions: No correction or retraction was found in GCN 46301–46310 or after ATel 18156 by the cutoff.
limitations: Modern GCN/Kafka notice streams were not independently enumerated.
No complete public KM3NeT live-alert ledger was available.
The GraceDB Latest page showed stale/inconsistent rows; the public REST created-time query was used for the window.
No claim of universal messenger quiet is made.
